detection_activity.definition: Raw satellite detection observations plus harmonized observations (matched groups collapsed once each by earliest-member period; ambiguous members counted individually; singles once). Observations, not fires; legitimate repeat observations are never deduplicated.

cluster_activity.definition: Spatial-temporal hotspot-cluster counts (observation groups, never individual wildfires), attributed to the first-observation period.

frp_summary.definition: Reported Fire Radiative Power aggregated per sensor. Cross-sensor FRP is not directly comparable (pixel size / sensitivity differ).

rows.method: sum-of-reported-FRP (repeated observations included; NOT total emitted energy)

detection_activity.definition: Raw satellite detection observations plus harmonized observations (matched groups collapsed once each by earliest-member period; ambiguous members counted individually; singles once). Observations, not fires; legitimate repeat observations are never deduplicated.

cluster_activity.definition: Spatial-temporal hotspot-cluster counts (observation groups, never individual wildfires), attributed to the first-observation period.

frp_summary.definition: Reported Fire Radiative Power aggregated per sensor. Cross-sensor FRP is not directly comparable (pixel size / sensitivity differ).
